findings.title: subPath names a file the volume does not have
findings.cause: container app mounts /etc/app/config.yaml with subPath config.yaml, but ConfigMap app-config has no such key (it has config.yml), so the kubelet made an empty directory in its place: the container finds a directory at /etc/app/config.yaml and exits; its log says: "cat: read error: Is a directory"; Deployment app has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container app exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container app's log (current run)
evidence.detail: cat: read error: Is a directory

evidence.what: ConfigMap app-config has config.yml, not config.yaml
evidence.command: kubectl get configmap app-config -n kd-subpath-key-missing -o jsonpath='{.data}'

evidence.what: container app mounts volume config at /etc/app/config.yaml with subPath config.yaml

findings.fix: Make subPath name a key ConfigMap app-config has, or add key config.yaml to it; then delete the pod, because the directory the kubelet made stays until the pod is replaced (and a subPath mount never sees later updates to the ConfigMap).
